Definition: to be able, literally (can, could) or morally (may, might)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to prevail, overcome, endure, have power, be able; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be able, be able to gain or accomplish, be able to endure, be able to reach; 1a2) to prevail, prevail over or against, overcome, be victor; 1a3) to have ability, have strength
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
